title: Card
description: A credit or debit card linked to a Moov account as a payment source.

fingerprint.description: Unique fingerprint identifying the underlying card number.

lastFourCardNumber.description: Last four digits of the card number.

bin.description: First six digits of the card number (Bank Identification Number).

holderName.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the card.

issuer.description: Name of the card-issuing financial institution.

issuerCountry.description: Two-letter ISO country code of the card issuer.

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the card was linked.

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the card was last updated.
